scenario.task:
I want to port my mobile number out to another carrier, which requires cancelling my current line

User Guide: Tell the agent you want to port out your number. Provide your authentication details when prompted. Listen to the contract disclosure and confirm If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
